prompt._raw_prompt: 英文：Produce a panoramic view of a calm lake with deep turquoise water, perfectly reflecting snow-capped mountains, dense evergreen forests, and a partly cloudy sky. Highlight the symmetry of the reflection and the serene, crisp atmosphere of a mountain lake. 中文：制作一幅平静湖泊的全景，深青绿色的湖水完美倒映着雪山、茂密的常绿森林和多云的天空。突出倒影的对称性以及高山湖泊宁静、清透的氛围。
